recognize_zh: 紅血球幾乎只剩一圈淡粉紅色的細邊、中間大片空白（環形低色素 anulocytes），大小比中央小淋巴球的核還小，並有鉛筆狀細胞與較多血小板，是嚴重缺鐵性貧血的典型外觀。
features: Profound hypochromia: red cells reduced to thin pink rims with large central pallor (ring forms/anulocytes)
Microcytosis relative to the small lymphocyte nucleus (center)
Poikilocytosis with elongated pencil cells and oval forms
Platelets appear increased, including a small platelet clump
Mature small lymphocyte with normal morphology
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked hypochromia, with most red cells consisting of a thin rim of hemoglobin surrounding a greatly expanded central pallor, and pronounced microcytosis compared with a normal small lymphocyte. Poikilocytosis includes elongated pencil cells. Platelets appear increased. Target cells, basophilic stippling and nucleated red cells are not evident. Findings are consistent with severe iron deficiency anemia.

ddx.vs: Shows marked target cells, basophilic stippling and numerous nucleated red cells with normal or high iron stores, rather than pure ring-form hypochromia.
Typically shows a dimorphic population with Pappenheimer bodies and ring sideroblasts on marrow iron stain.
Rarely produces this degree of hypochromia and is associated with normal or raised ferritin.
